digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / ticket review audit rendering
propositions: Plan-material-pin health data must be consumed and displayed consistently across detailed CLI show, MCP ticket detail, audit output, close errors, and web ticket-review UI using the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract without independent status string definitions.

Pin drift, enforcement posture, review-phase compatibility, pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, and required phase must be rendered in detailed surfaces while ordinary list output and persisted ticket events remain unchanged.
When pin enforcement is disabled, observed drift must be labeled advisory and distinguished from legacy-unpinned state without altering overall validity presentation.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity at the build_context/page assembly boundary after audit_trail completes, catching missing attestation or timeouts without changing audit_trail never-raise behavior.

Output schemas, rendering tests, and advanced documentation must cover pins, phases, toggles, deleted targets, close-versus-claim freshness, and deletion repair without adding material-pin details to basic user documentation.
Schema changes must be additive and preserve rollback compatibility across CLI, MCP, audit text/JSON, close-error, and web rendering paths.
